scope: Frozen periodic 2D interference with eight coherent carriers and a smooth envelope; exact finite Fourier density and potential. No time integration, cosmological halo, or GAMER binary. Nested model uses exact fine sources, direct point-centered FD2 solves and polynomial boundary transfer. Hessian errors use identical finite-difference diagnostics on numerical and reference potentials, not an additional force stencil comparison.
normalization: L=2*pi; mean density=1; Delta Phi=rho-1. Axis bandwidth K=10 in psi, 20 in density, 30 in instantaneous Phi*psi. The diagonal carriers have smaller Euclidean wave number than K. All source modes resolved at n=50.
